framing: Public data rarely breaks out Asian American women by ethnicity, and that gap is part of the problem Kin addresses: when data hides a community, services miss it. Every figure below is quoted from its source or computed from DHCS open data with the method stated.
computed_note: Bay Area figures are Kin's sums over the nine Bay Area counties (Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Solano, Sonoma) from the DHCS Medi-Cal Certified Eligibles open data, month of eligibility October 2026 (preliminary, updated October 29, 2026).

headline.text: Asian Medi-Cal members in the Bay Area in October 2026, about 19% of the region's 1.86 million members, double the statewide API share of 9.3%.
headline.source: DHCS Medi-Cal Certified Eligibles by Race/Ethnicity and Age Group (Oct 2026), Kin sum; statewide share from DHCS Health Equity Roadmap

headline.text: Asian Medi-Cal members age 65+ in the Bay Area, 35% of all Asian members here. In San Francisco it is 42% (29,533 of 70,853).
headline.source: DHCS Medi-Cal Certified Eligibles by Race/Ethnicity and Age Group (Oct 2026), Kin sum

headline.text: of Bay Area Medi-Cal members age 65+ are women (175,675 women, 117,762 men). Women are also 54% of members age 19 to 44.
headline.source: DHCS Medi-Cal Certified Eligibles by Age Group and Sex (Oct 2026), Kin sum

headline.text: Bay Area Medi-Cal members whose primary language is Chinese (108,250: Cantonese 77,940, Mandarin 28,860, other 1,450), Vietnamese (53,300), Tagalog or Ilocano (12,338), Hindi or Punjabi (5,108), or Korean (4,009). Every one of them receives county notices written in English first.
headline.source: DHCS Medi-Cal Certified Eligibles by Primary Language (Oct 2026), Kin sum

data_gaps: DHCS open data reports race and language separately, so no public table shows Asian American women by ethnicity and age.
No public source we found reports how many Asian American women 65+ live alone in the Bay Area by ethnicity.
Indian American elders are missing from the California food insecurity and life satisfaction studies cited above.
The CHCF 2024 report is statewide only and does not analyze women or older adults as groups.
